summary: Man and woman whose truck had been stuck on County Road 80C since Sunday morning (2020-01-26) were located by helicopter on Tuesday afternoon and safely evacuated, uninjured. LCSAR was mobilizing resources to assist when the helicopter found them.
notes: Date approximate: 2020-01-29 post and shared news link say the parties were found 'Tuesday afternoon' (2020-01-28) after being stuck since Sunday morning.
